project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.

is_confirmed.instructions: You are triaging a security scanner finding for the project described in the state. Does this finding describe a genuine security issue that warrants action in this project? Judge only from the finding and the project context provided.
